mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId,o.order_no AS orderNo,o.user_id AS userId,o.project_id AS projectId, o.order_status AS orderStatus,o.payment_status AS paymentStatus,o.delivery_type AS deliveryType, COALESCE(q.delivery_mode,CASE WHEN o.delivery_fee_amount>0 THEN 'EXPRESS' ELSE NULL END) AS deliveryMode, o.delivery_fee_amount AS deliveryFeeAmount,b.bridge_id AS bridgeId,b.provider_id AS providerId, p.provider_code AS providerCode,b.provider_order_id AS providerOrderId,b.bridge_status AS bridgeStatus, COALESCE((SELECT rr.delivery_fee_refundable FROM refund_rule rr WHERE rr.project_id=o.project_id ORDER BY rr.refund_rule_id DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS deliveryFeeRuleRefundable FROM ticket_order o JOIN ticket_source_order_bridge b ON b.order_id=o.order_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=b.provider_id LEFT JOIN ticket_source_order_quote q ON q.quote_id=b.quote_id
mapper.select: WHERE o.order_id=#{orderId} AND o.user_id=#{userId} AND b.order_model='SINGLE_SKU' LIMIT 1

SELECT shipment_id AS shipmentId,order_bridge_id AS orderBridgeId,provider_shipment_id AS providerShipmentId, shipment_status AS shipmentStatus,carrier_code AS carrierCode,carrier_name AS carrierName, waybill_no AS waybillNo,tracking_url AS trackingUrl,shipped_time AS shippedTime,signed_time AS signedTime, last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime,provider_version AS providerVersion,last_sync_status AS lastSyncStatus, last_error_code AS lastErrorCode,last_error_message AS lastErrorMessage FROM ticket_source_shipment WHERE order_bridge_id=#{bridgeId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_source_shipment SET shipment_status='NOT_REQUIRED',last_sync_status='SUCCESS',last_sync_time=#{syncTime}, last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_bridge_id=#{bridgeId} AND shipment_status='WAIT_SHIPMENT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_source_shipment (order_bridge_id,shipment_status,carrier_code,carrier_name,waybill_no,tracking_url, shipped_time,signed_time,last_sync_time,provider_version,last_sync_status,last_error_code,last_error_message, create_time,update_time) VALUES (#{bridgeId},#{shipmentStatus},#{carrierCode},#{carrierName},#{waybillNo},#{trackingUrl}, #{shippedTime},#{signedTime},#{lastSyncTime},#{providerVersion},'SUCCESS',NULL,NULL,NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE shipment_status=VALUES(shipment_status),carrier_code=COALESCE(VALUES(carrier_code),carrier_code), carrier_name=COALESCE(VALUES(carrier_name),carrier_name),waybill_no=COALESCE(VALUES(waybill_no),waybill_no), tracking_url=COALESCE(VALUES(tracking_url),tracking_url), shipped_time=COALESCE(VALUES(shipped_time),shipped_time),signed_time=COALESCE(VALUES(signed_time),signed_time), last_sync_time=VALUES(last_sync_time),provider_version=VALUES(provider_version),last_sync_status='SUCCESS', last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,update_time=NOW()
mapper.select: JOIN ticket_source_shipment s ON s.order_bridge_id=b.bridge_id WHERE o.delivery_type='PAPER_TICKET' AND o.order_status IN ('WAIT_USE','FINISHED','COMPLETED','REFUNDING','REFUND_SUCCESS') AND b.provider_order_id IS NOT NULL AND (q.delivery_mode='EXPRESS' OR (q.delivery_mode IS NULL AND o.delivery_fee_amount>0)) AND ( (s.shipment_status IN ('WAIT_SHIPMENT','SHIPPED','IN_TRANSIT','EXCEPTION') AND (s.last_sync_time IS NULL OR s.last_sync_time<=#{staleBefore})) OR (s.shipment_status='DELIVERED' AND (s.last_sync_time IS NULL OR s.last_sync_time<=#{deliveredStaleBefore})) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(s.last_sync_time,s.create_time),s.shipment_id LIMIT #{limit}
